# .github/pii-patterns.example.txt
#
# Starting point for .github/pii-patterns.txt, which is maintainer-private
# and excluded from the public snapshot (see docs/guides/two-remote-sync.md).
# Copy this file to .github/pii-patterns.txt and replace the placeholder
# patterns below with your own real tokens. That file never ships publicly.
#
# Format: one POSIX extended regex (grep -E syntax) per line, consumed by
# scripts/public_release_gate.sh. Blank lines and lines starting with `#`
# are ignored. Every match found in the filtered export tree is a blocking
# hit unless waived in .github/release-waivers.txt (format:
# `path:pattern # reason`).
#
# This is a blacklist, not an allowlist — false positives (e.g. known
# placeholder emails like user@example.com) are expected and get waived
# individually, not filtered out here. See CLAUDE.md Hard-won rule #1.

# --- Government/national ID number formats (example: replace with yours) ---
# 8 digits + control letter
\b[0-9]{8}[A-HJ-NP-TV-Z]\b

# --- Brand / personal name tokens ---
# Add each real brand, venture, or personal name that must not leak.
YOUR_BRAND
YOUR_NAME

# --- Email / domain addresses ---
# Add each real personal or venture email domain as its own token.
# Deliberately not a generic any-email regex — that only ever matches
# documentation placeholders and trains rubber-stamp waivers.
your-domain\.com

# --- Address hints ---
# Add any street/city fragments that would identify a real location.
\bYOUR_CITY\b

# --- Secrets ---
# 16+ key chars avoids matching prose like "risk-taking" / "task-icon".
\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}
api_key[[:space:]]*=
BEGIN [A-Za-z ]*PRIVATE KEY

# --- Private project codenames ---
# Add any internal/unreleased project codenames that must not leak.
YOUR_CODENAME

# --- Absolute local paths (leaks local machine username) ---
/Users/[a-z]+/
